newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arab shepherd killed two Israeli girls - army.
newsitem.headline: Arab shepherd killed two Israeli girls - army.

text.p: Israeli security forces have arrested an Arab shepherd on suspicion of stabbing to death two teenage Israeli girls in a West Bank nature reserve in April, the army said on Thursday.
A security official said the bedouin had murdered the girls for "nationalist reasons" but was not linked to any Palestinian guerrilla group.
"According to his confession...he thought the girls had weapons and wanted to steal them. The girls were not armed," an army spokeswoman said.
The bodies were found by hikers in the Wadi Kelt nature reserve, a popular West Bank tourist site.
The suspect was arrested two days after the killings. It was not clear why authorities waited until now to announce the arrest.
The spokeswoman said investigators had recovered the knife used in the stabbings, a bloodstained shirt belonging to the suspect and a camera owned by one of the victims.
